title: Technical Support Manager — D365 CE or FNO
description:
**Description**
Company Overview:
  
  
When it comes to IT solution providers, there are a lot of choices. But when it comes to providers with innovative and differentiating end-to-end service offerings, there’s really only one: Zones – First Choice for IT.TM
  
  
Zones is a Global Solution Provider of end-to-end IT solutions with an unmatched supply chain. Positioned to be the IT partner you need, Zones, a Minority Business Enterprise (MBE) in business for over 35 years, specializes in Digital Workplace, Cloud & Data Center, Networking, Security, and Managed/Professional/Staffing services. Operating in more than 120 countries, leveraging a robust portfolio, and utilizing the highest certification levels from key partners, including Microsoft, Apple, Cisco, Lenovo, Adobe, and more, Zones has mastered the science of building digital infrastructures that change the way business does business ensuring whatever they need, they can Consider IT Done. Follow Zones, LLC on Twitter @Zones, and LinkedIn and Facebook.
  
  
**Position Overview**
We are seeking a committed and hands-on Technical Support Manager to lead our Dynamics 365 Customer Engagement (D365 CE or FNO) support function. The successful candidate will manage a team of more than ten support engineers and maintenance staff, work across multiple rotational shifts to ensure round-the-clock coverage, and serve as the first point of escalation for SLA breaches and production outages.
  
  
This role combines deep functional expertise in D365 CE and sales processes (Order-to-Cash) with strong people leadership, process governance, and a continuous-improvement mindset. The Technical Support Manager will also oversee 2 to 5 short-term initiatives (1 to 6 months in duration) focused on bug fixes, technical-debt reduction, and incremental enhancements.
  
  
What you’ll do as the Technical Support Manager — D365 CE or FNO :
  
  
Support Operations and SLA Management
  
  

* Operate the D365 CE support function and ensure all support tickets are resolved within agreed SLAs.
* Act as the first point of escalation for SLA breaches, P1/P2 incidents, and production outages.
* Govern the support playbook; continuously improve processes through automation and root-cause prevention.
* Perform detailed Root Cause Analysis (RCA) on critical issues and drive permanent fixes.
* Define, track, and report on key support metrics and KPIs (MTTR, first-response time, ticket aging, CSAT).

Team and Project Management
  
  

* Lead and mentor a team of 10+ support engineers and maintenance staff across multiple shifts.
* Manage 2 to 5 short-term projects (1 to 6 months) covering bug fixes, technical debt, and minor enhancements.
* Run scrum ceremonies — sprint planning, daily stand-ups, retrospectives — and deliver high-quality fixes on schedule.
* Conduct performance reviews, capacity planning, and skills development for the team.

Quality and Knowledge Management
  
  

* Ensure quality checks on knowledge-base articles and ticket-closure documentation.
* Develop new runbooks and update existing ones based on incident learnings and data-driven decisions.
* Promote a culture of documentation, peer review, and continuous learning within the team.

D365 CE and Sales Process (Must Have)
  
  

* D365 CE: Hands-on experience with Dynamics 365 Customer Engagement (D365 CE) as an end-user, support engineer, or developer.
* Sales Process: Strong understanding of the sales process — Sales Orders, Pricing, Quotes, Opportunities, and Accounts.
* O2C / P2P: Proficiency in Order-to-Cash (O2C) and/or Procure-to-Pay (P2P) flows, with depth in one or more of: Sales Order, Pricing, Finance O2C, P2P, Tax.
* Modules: Good to moderate proficiency across D365 CE modules with the ability to navigate, troubleshoot, and configure as needed.

Technical Skills
  
  

* Intermediate to advanced SQL — writing queries, analyzing data, and supporting incident investigation.
* Strong troubleshooting skills with attention to detail and the ability to apply learnings across issues.
* Familiarity with monitoring, logging, and ITSM tools (e.g., ServiceNow, Azure Monitor, Application Insights).

Leadership and Soft Skills
  
  

* Proven ability to manage and motivate teams across multiple geographies and time zones.
* Excellent oral and written communication; able to brief executives and engage with business stakeholders.
* Fast learner with strong problem-solving instincts and a bias for action.
* Calm under pressure during outages and high-severity incidents.

**What You Will Bring To The Team**

* 12+ years of overall IT experience, 5+ years of hands-on D365 CE or FNO experience (end-user, support, or developer role).
* 5+ years managing teams of 10 or more members, with proven team-building track record.
* Demonstrated experience supporting users and systems across multiple geographies.

Zones offers a comprehensive Benefits package.
  
  
While we’re committed to providing top-tier solutions, we’re just as committed to supporting our own teams. We offer a competitive compensation package where our team members are rewarded based on their performance and recognized for the value they bring into our business. Our team members enjoy a variety of comprehensive benefits, including Medical Insurance Coverage, Group Term Life and Personal Accident Cover to handle the uncertainties of life, flexible leave policy to balance their work life.
  
  
At Zones, work is more than a job – it's an exciting career immersed in an inventive, collaborative culture. If you’re interested in working on the cutting edge of IT innovation, sales, engineering, operations, administration, and more, Zones is the place for you!
  
  
All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment and will not be discriminated against on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, age, genetic information, or pregnancy.

title: Backup Administrator
description:
**Experience- 8-10 years**

**Role & Responsibilities**

• Lead a team of Backup & Recovery Administrators and provide 24x7 Production Support.

• Handle escalated incidents and critical tickets.

• Troubleshoot and resolve complex issues escalated from L1/L2 support teams.

• Anticipate and Predict Risks/Impact on Production Environment and handle Major Changes.

• Manage and Report Performance Dashboards with Capacity Planning.

• Perform root cause analysis and implement long-term solutions for recurring problems.

• Collaborate with Cohesity engineering and product teams for bug fixes and enhancements.

• Monitor system performance and proactively identify potential issues.

• Maintain detailed documentation of issues, resolutions, and best practices.

• Participate in on-call rotation for critical incident support.

• Ensure compliance with banking industry standards and security protocols.

• Design, Migration and upgradation of existing Backup Infrastructure.

• Provide advanced technical support for Cohesity products including backup, recovery, and data management solutions.

• Create suggested target backup schedules and operational plans.

• Design Media retention plans and media management process.

• Ensure all backup jobs are scheduled appropriately and expediently.

• Prepare Backup reports from the existing tools.

• Agent Installation and configuration of backups of FS, DB (Oracle, MSSQL, MySQL, PostgreSQL, MongoDB), AD, Exchange)

**Job Requirements/Descriptions)**

• Level 3 Backup & Recovery SME and Administrator.

• Good knowledge on Data duplication, deduplication and replication concepts.

• Well versed with Backup and Recovery planning and implementation.

• Media Management & Vendor Coordination.

• Troubleshooting complex problems.

• Candidate is expected to have complex production support experience.

• Backup Solution Server / Client installations.

• Patching & Upgradation.

• Advanced documentation skills.

• Recovery of Backup Server from failure.

• Change Management Planning and Implementation.

• Disaster Recovery Support (plan & participate).

• Backup tool migration.

**Technical Skills Required**

• Expert in design, configuration and implementation of Cohesity.

• Hands-on experience with Veritas NetBackup (Cohesity) platform (DataProtect, Helios, SmartFiles, etc.).

• High Availability Configurations.

• Custom Design.

• Performance Management of Backup Infrastructure.

• Tape Library configuration.

• Disk to Disk and Disk to Disk to Tape configurations.

• Recovery experience with specific backup modules like Oracle, MSSQL, MS Exchange, VMWare snapshot and SharePoint.

• Knowledge on BMR backup configuration and recovery.

• Knowledge on Cohesity replication and reporting.

• Knowledge on restoration from tape library.

• Exposure on VMWare infra

**Specific Domain/Technical/Functional skills**

• Strong troubleshooting skills in Backup Infrastructure environment and advanced problem-solving skills.

• Proactive measures and preventive measures for problems/errors.

• Management of Backup SLAs and KPIs.

• Liaise with vendors & OEMs for the technical issues / escalations.

• Drive major incidents and resolutions.

• Documentation & Operational performance reporting.

• People management and skills development.

• Own and Drive Service Improvement plans.

• Identify, own and mitigate risks.

• Ensure compliance to client and organization processes and policies.

• Perform backup performance tuning.

• Should have relevant scripting knowledge.

• Preparing scripting tools for automation.

• Exposure to mid-range & high-end servers and backup appliances.

• Exposure on clustering & High Availability.

• License Management.

• Enable and support the team in resolving day-to-day production issues, disaster recovery exercise, capacity planning and other activities as may be necessary.

• ITIL Certified preferred.

description:
Choosing Capgemini means choosing a company where you will be empowered to shape your career in the way you’d like, where you’ll be supported and inspired by a collaborative community of colleagues around the world, and where you’ll be able to reimagine what’s possible. Join us and help the world’s leading organizations unlock the value of technology and build a more sustainable, more inclusive world.
  
  
**Job Description**
**Key Responsibilities:**

* Implement, configure, and support SAP Cloud ALM solutions for enterprise customers.
* Design and maintain monitoring capabilities including Business Process Monitoring, Health Monitoring, Integration Monitoring, and Job Monitoring.
* Support SAP S/4HANA transformation programs and cloud adoption initiatives.
* Leverage SAP Solution Manager expertise for change management, test management, ChaRM, monitoring, and project delivery activities.
* Configure dashboards, alert management, reporting, and analytics within SAP Cloud ALM.
* Collaborate with functional, technical, and infrastructure teams to ensure effective application lifecycle management.
* Troubleshoot issues related to SAP systems, integrations, and monitoring frameworks.

**Job Description - Requirement**
**Required Skills:**

* Strong hands-on experience in SAP Cloud ALM (CALM).
* Proven experience with SAP Solution Manager (SolMan), including ChaRM, Test Suite, Monitoring, and ITSM.
* Good understanding of SAP S/4HANA, SAP BTP, SAP Integration Suite, and SAP ecosystem.
* Experience in SAP implementation, upgrade, migration, and support projects.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.

**What You Will Love About Working Here**
You can shape your career with us. We offer a range of career paths and internal opportunities within Capgemini group. You will also get personalized career guidance from our leaders.You will get comprehensive wellness benefits including health checks, telemedicine, insurance with top-ups, elder care, partner coverage or new parent support via flexible work.At Capgemini, you can work on cutting-edge projects in tech and engineering with industry leaders or create solutions to overcome societal and environmental challenges.
  
  
Capgemini is an AI-powered global business and technology transformation partner, delivering tangible business value. We imagine the future of organizations and make it real with AI, technology and people. With our strong heritage of nearly 60 years, we are a responsible and diverse group of 420,000 team members in more than 50 countries. We deliver end-to-end services and solutions with our deep industry expertise and strong partner ecosystem, leveraging our capabilities across strategy, technology, design, engineering and business operations. The Group reported 2024 global revenues of €22.1 billion.
